mismatches.say: Under the twenty thirteen claims-made C G L, the basic tail is free and automatic. It gives sixty days for occurrences never reported, and five years for those reported no later than sixty days after the end.

mismatches.say: Neither tail covers injury after the policy ends.

mismatches.say: A tail is like leaving the porch light on after a party that started at the retro date. Late knocks still get answered, but only from guests who were at the party, never from new arrivals.

mismatches.say: Grace reports it tonight. When the guest sues in August, the basic tail covers it: reported in time, so five years.

mismatches.say: A package is common declarations and conditions plus two or more parts. A is injury and damage, B the four P's, C med pay: no fault needed, but a one-year clock. Supplementary payments ride on top: up to two hundred fifty dollars for bail bonds, two hundred fifty dollars a day for lost earnings.
